newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-NEWLY-ARRIVED BILARDO THREATENS TO LEAVE SEVILLA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEWLY-ARRIVED BILARDO THREATENS TO LEAVE SEVILLA.

text.p: Former Argentina team chief Carlos Bilardo has threatened to go home less than a week after returning to manage troubled Spanish club Sevilla.
Bilardo, who has not yet signed a contract with Sevilla, said on Monday: "If we don't reach agreement over a load of things tomorrow (Tuesday) or the day after I'll be in Buenos Aires."
Jose Antonio Camacho resigned as manager last week. Bilardo sat in the stands during Sunday's defeat at Zaragoza and directed the team by mobile phone.
Sevilla, struggling next to bottom in the league, have been wracked by a series of finanancial problems.
Manuel Ruiz de Lopera, owner of local rivals Real Betis, said he had been offered a controlling interest in Sevilla.
